title: Community Solar Subscriptions Fee Basis, Invoice Lag and Rounding by Plan
content:
For every plan of Community Solar Subscriptions, the monthly subscription fee is computed on the same basis: the value of the solar bill credit the utility applied, multiplied by 100 less the plan's discount percentage, divided by 100. The plans also share the invoice lag, the minimum fee and the rounding convention.

## Billing parameters by plan

| Plan | Fee basis | Invoice lag (utility billing cycles) | Minimum subscription fee per cycle | Rounding of fees and credits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Flex | bill credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | 1 | $0.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 1-Year | bill credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | 1 | $0.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 5-Year | bill credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | 1 | $0.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 10-Year | bill credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | 1 | $0.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share 20-Year | bill credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | 1 | $0.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge Solar Share Income-Eligible | bill credit multiplied by (100 less discount), divided by 100 | 1 | $0.00 | half up to the cent |

## Definitions

- **Fee basis.** The monthly subscription fee is computed as the bill credit value multiplied by 100 less the discount percentage, divided by 100.
- **Invoice lag.** The invoice lag is the number of utility billing cycles between the cycle whose credit is applied and the Beacon Ridge invoice; on every plan it is 1 cycle.
- **Minimum fee.** The minimum subscription fee per cycle is $0.00 on every plan.
- **Rounding.** Fees and credits are rounded to the cent, with a remainder of exactly half a cent rounding up.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Hypothetical bill credit of $62.50 on a hypothetical plan discount of 12.0%:

1. 100 less 12.0 is 88.0.
2. $62.50 multiplied by 88.0 is 5,500.00; divided by 100 that is $55.00.
3. No rounding is needed; $55.00 is not below the $0.00 minimum, so the fee is $55.00.

Hypothetical bill credit of $41.15 on a hypothetical discount of 10.0%: $41.15 multiplied by 90.0, divided by 100, is $37.035, exactly half a cent above $37.03, so it rounds up to **$37.04**.
